title: AnalysisLibrary
description: Every stored analysis of one repository, most recent first, as the facts a reviewer chooses between: when, which model, what it cost, how large the change was. Returned by analysis.list and analysis.delete. Listing never reads a document, and reopening one is analysis.get with its id — neither starts a conversation.

repositoryPath.description: Absolute path of the worktree root these analyses belong to.

retentionLimit.description: How many analyses are kept per repository. Storing another beyond this removes the oldest; the library says so rather than letting runs disappear unexplained.

entries.description: The stored analyses, most recent first. Empty when the repository has never been analysed.

analysisId.description: Identifier to reopen, inspect or delete it by.

providerDisplayName.description: Display name of the provider profile that produced it.

costUsd.description: What the run cost in US dollars, as a decimal string. Absent when the model is not in the price table — unknown, never zero.

headCommit.description: The commit HEAD pointed at when it ran. Absent in a repository with no commits.

fileCount.description: Changed files in the changeset it analysed.

isLatest.description: True for the most recent analysis, which is the one the screen opens by default.
